# BRIEFING: Regex Matcher - Quantifier Backtracking Issue

**GOAL:**
Implement a regex matcher supporting literals, dots, character classes, quantifiers (*, +, ?), groups, alternation, anchors, and escapes. Must pass all test cases including greedy matching with proper backtracking.

**STATE:**
- Parser is complete and working: converts pattern string to AST
- Basic matching logic implemented for all node types
- Quantifier matching uses greedy approach with backtracking
- Test suite exists but failing on: `full_match('a*ab', 'aaab')` should return `True`

**DONE:**
- Pattern parsing (alternation, sequences, atoms, classes, groups, escapes)
- Character class matching with ranges and negation
- Anchor handling (^ and $)
- Dot and literal matching
- Basic quantifier structure

**BROKEN:**
The greedy backtracking algorithm in `match_greedy()` is fundamentally flawed:
- Current logic: matches greedily, then backtracks only if the *next* recursive call fails
- Problem: doesn't backtrack to allow subsequent pattern atoms to match
- Example: `'a*ab'` on `'aaab'` — the `a*` consumes all three `a`s, then `a` fails to match `b`, but backtracking never happens because `match_greedy()` only returns after consuming, never tries fewer matches
- The function needs to continue matching the *rest of the pattern* after each greedy attempt, not just try more quantifier matches

**NEXT:**
Rewrite `match_quantifier()` and `match_greedy()` to use proper backtracking:
1. For `*` and `+`: collect all possible match lengths (0 to max)
2. Try matching the rest of the pattern at each length, starting

parse_pattern(pattern)\\n        result = match_pattern(parsed, text, 0)\\n        return result == len(text)\\n    except ValueError:\\n        raise\\n\\n\\ndef parse_pattern(pattern):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse pattern string into an AST.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    tokens, pos = parse_alternation(pattern, 0)\\n    if pos != len(pattern):\\n        raise ValueError(f\\\"Unexpected character at position {pos}\\\")\\n    return tokens\\n\\n\\ndef parse_alternation(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse alternation (lowest precedence): a|b|c\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    left, pos = parse_sequence(pattern, pos)\\n    \\n    if pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] == '|':\\n        alternatives = [left]\\n        while pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] == '|':\\n            pos += 1\\n            right, pos = parse_sequence(pattern, pos)\\n            alternatives.append(right)\\n        return ('alternation', alternatives), pos\\n    \\n    return left, pos\\n\\n\\ndef parse_sequence(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse sequence of atoms with quantifiers.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    atoms = []\\n    \\n    while pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] not in '|)':\\n        atom, pos = parse_atom(pattern, pos)\\n        \\n        # Check for quantifier\\n        if pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] in '*+?':\\n            quantifier = pattern[pos]\\n            pos += 1\\n            atom = ('quantifier', quantifier, atom)\\n        \\n        atoms.append(atom)\\n    \\n    if len(atoms) == 0:\\n        return ('sequence', []), pos\\n    elif len(atoms) == 1:\\n        return atoms[0], pos\\n    else:\\n        return ('sequence', atoms), pos\\n\\n\\ndef parse_atom(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse a single atom (literal, dot, class, group, or anchor).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if pos >= len(pattern):\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Unexpected end of pattern\\\")\\n    \\n    ch = pattern[pos]\\n    \\n    if ch == '^':\\n        return ('anchor', '^'), pos + 1\\n    elif ch == '$':\\n        return ('anchor', '$'), pos + 1\\n    elif ch == '.':\\n        return ('dot',), pos + 1\\n    elif ch == '[':\\n        return parse_class(pattern, pos)\\n    elif ch == '(':\\n        return parse_group(pattern, pos)\\n    elif ch == '\\\\\\\\':\\n        return parse_escape(pattern, pos)\\n    elif ch in '*+?)':\\n        raise ValueError(f\\\"Quantifier '{ch}' with no preceding atom\\\")\\n    else:\\n        return ('literal', ch), pos + 1\\n\\n\\ndef parse_escape(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse escaped character.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if pos + 1 >= len(pattern):\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Incomplete escape sequence\\\")\\n    \\n    next_ch = pattern[pos + 1]\\n    return ('literal', next_ch), pos + 2\\n\\n\\ndef parse_class(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse character class [abc], [a-z], [^abc].\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if pos >= len(pattern) or pattern[pos] != '[':\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Expected '['\\\")\\n    \\n    pos += 1\\n    negated = False\\n    \\n    if pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] == '^':\\n        negated = True\\n        pos += 1\\n    \\n    ranges = []\\n    \\n    while pos < len(pattern) and pattern[pos] != ']':\\n        if pattern[pos] == '\\\\\\\\':\\n            # Escaped character in class\\n            if pos + 1 >= len(pattern):\\n                raise ValueError(\\\"Incomplete escape in character class\\\")\\n            ch = pattern[pos + 1]\\n            pos += 2\\n            ranges.append(('char', ch))\\n        else:\\n != ']':\\n                pos += 1  # consume '-'\\n                end_ch = pattern[pos]\\n                pos += 1\\n                ranges.append(('range', ch, end_ch))\\n            else:\\n                ranges.append(('char', ch))\\n    \\n    if pos >= len(pattern):\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Unclosed character class\\\")\\n    \\n    pos += 1  # consume ']'\\n    \\n    return ('class', negated, ranges), pos\\n\\n\\ndef parse_group(pattern, pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Parse group (...).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if pos >= len(pattern) or pattern[pos] != '(':\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Expected '('\\\")\\n    \\n    pos += 1\\n    inner, pos = parse_alternation(pattern, pos)\\n    \\n    if pos >= len(pattern) or pattern[pos] != ')':\\n        raise ValueError(\\\"Unclosed group\\\")\\n    \\n    pos += 1\\n    return ('group', inner), pos\\n\\n\\ndef match_pattern(parsed, text, text_pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Match pattern against text starting at text_pos.\\n    Returns the position in text after matching, or -1 if no match.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if isinstance(parsed, tuple):\\n        if parsed[0] == 'literal':\\n            if text_pos < len(text) and text[text_pos] == parsed[1]:\\n                return text_pos + 1\\n            return -1\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'dot':\\n            if text_pos < len(text):\\n                return text_pos + 1\\n            return -1\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'anchor':\\n            if parsed[1] == '^':\\n                return text_pos if text_pos == 0 else -1\\n            elif parsed[1] == '$':\\n                return text_pos if text_pos == len(text) else -1\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'class':\\n            if text_pos >= len(text):\\n                return -1\\n            ch = text[text_pos]\\n            negated, ranges = parsed[1], parsed[2]\\n            matches = char_in_class(ch, ranges)\\n            if matches != negated:\\n                return text_pos + 1\\n            return -1\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'sequence':\\n            pos = text_pos\\n            for atom in parsed[1]:\\n                result = match_pattern(atom, text, pos)\\n                if result == -1:\\n                    return -1\\n                pos = result\\n            return pos\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'quantifier':\\n            quantifier, atom = parsed[1], parsed[2]\\n            return match_quantifier(quantifier, atom, text, text_pos)\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'group':\\n            return match_pattern(parsed[1], text, text_pos)\\n        \\n        elif parsed[0] == 'alternation':\\n            for alternative in parsed[1]:\\n                result = match_pattern(alternative, text, text_pos)\\n                if result != -1:\\n                    return result\\n            return -1\\n    \\n    return -1\\n\\n\\ndef match_quantifier(quantifier, atom, text, text_pos):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Match quantified atom with backtracking.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if quantifier == '*':\\n        # Zero or more: try greedy, then backtrack\\n        return match_star(atom, text, text_pos)\\n    elif quantifier == '+':\\n        # One or more: must match at least once\\n        result = match_pattern(atom, text, text_pos)\\n        if result == -1:\\n            return -1\\n        return match_star(atom, text, result, min_matches=1)\\n    elif quantifier == '?':\\n        # Zero or one: try matching first, then no match\\n        result = match_pattern(atom, text, text_pos)\\n        if result != -1:\\n            return result\\n        return text_pos\\n    \\n    return -1\\n\\n\\ndef match_star(atom, text, text_pos, min_matches=0):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Match atom zero or more times (or one or more if min_matches=1).\\n    Greedy matching with backtracking support.\\n    Returns the position after matching, or -1 if no match.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    # Collect all possible match lengths by greedy matching\\n    positions = [text_pos]  # Start with 0 matches\\n    current_pos = text_pos\\n    \\n    # Keep matching greedily\\n    while True:\\n        result = match_pattern(atom, text, current_pos)\\n        if result == -1 or result == current_pos:\\n            break\\n        current_pos = result\\n        positions.append(current_pos)\\n    \\n    # Try positions from longest to shortest (greedy first, then backtrack)\\n    for pos in reversed(positions):\\n        if len(positions) - 1 - positions.index(pos) >= min_matches:\\n            yield pos\\n\\n\\ndef char_in_class(ch, ranges):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Check if character is in the given ranges.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    for item in ranges:\\n        if item[0] == 'char':\\n            if ch == item[1]:\\n                return True\\n        elif item[0] == 'range':\\n            start, end = item[1], item[2]\\n            if ord(start) <= ord(ch) <= ord(end):\\n                return True\\n    return False\\n\"}"}}]}
